newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips end higher in light pre-Christmas trading.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips end higher in light pre-Christmas trading.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended an abbreviated trading session with moderate gains Tuesday as investors scooped up big-name stocks and rushed off to celebrate the Christmas holiday.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 33.83 points at 6,522.84. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 12-9 on very light volume of 166 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The market closed early at 1 p.m. EST/1800 GMT and will be shut Wednesday, Christmas day.
